description: [STAGE 3: SYNTAX & STACKS] Retrieve complete chart markup, CSS theme tokens (--chart-1..5), layout footprint, client options, and framework mount code (vanilla, astro, react, vue, svelte) with optional theme token overrides for a specific chart blueprint ID or category. Next step: Call basecoat_quality_inspector to audit the assembled page.

chartId.description: Chart blueprint ID from basecoat_list_charts (e.g., area-default, area-stacked, bar-multiple, pie-donut, radar-default, radial-half, tooltip-default). Also accepts category name or keyword alias.

engine.description: Chart rendering engine (svg or apexcharts). Defaults to svg.

environment.description: Target environment (html, astro, react, vue, svelte). Defaults to html.

framework.description: Target framework mount generator (vanilla, astro, react, vue, svelte, html). When html or omitted, resolves to vanilla.

id.description: Alias for chartId. Defaults to "area-default" if neither chartId nor id is provided.

name: basecoat_get_chart_blueprint
